target: PDT-II (1)/(4): compatible refinement when defect spaces grow

theorem.hypotheses: U embeds in V; q=dim(V/U). Coarse A:U->Y and refined B:V->Z are record-compatible: A=P(B|U) for some P.

balances.revealed: Delta revealed = inherited revelation gain + new-sector visible gain
balances.hidden: Delta hidden = q - inherited revelation gain - new-sector visible gain

consequences: refined revealed rank >= coarse revealed rank
refined hidden dimension <= coarse hidden dimension + q
q=0 recovers Cycle 097 fixed-space hidden monotonicity

smallest_incompatibility_counterexample.falsifies: unqualified revealed-rank monotonicity without a record-compatibility/no-erasure condition

prior_art_boundary: The mathematical core is rank-nullity/exact-sequence linear algebra; nested vector spaces with compatible maps are standard filtration/persistence structures. No novelty is claimed for the abstract theorem.
open: Derive from PDT primitives why physical resource refinement induces both an embedding of inherited defect spaces and a compatible record map, then test whether that structure constrains composition or yields a same-input PDT-vs-QM prediction.
